packageRules.description: WHY NO AUTOMERGE ANYWHERE: every dependency bump rewrites yarn.lock, which changes the native fingerprint (runtimeVersion policy: fingerprint). A merged bump strands OTA reach to every installed binary until a new store build ships, so no dependency update in this repo is routine — each one implies a release. A human decides when that happens. WHY baseBranches IS stg: main is the production trigger. A push to main touching package.json/yarn.lock fires expo-store-deploy-prd, which builds AND submits to both stores. Renovate targeting the default branch would auto-submit releases.
Expo SDK — update all expo packages atomically so expo doctor never sees a mismatch
React Native Firebase — keep all Firebase packages on the same major
Tamagui — update all tamagui packages together
TypeScript + types — safe to automerge patch/minor
Patch-only updates for everything else — automerge safely

schedule: on the first day of the month
